Support

Let’s get your morning working.

Quick answers for alarms, videos, and permissions.

Need help?

Check the answers below. Direct support is available through the developer contact shown with Motivational Clock Alarm on the App Store.

View quick answers

My alarm did not appear

Open the app’s Settings screen and confirm that Alarm permission is allowed. Also make sure the alarm is enabled and includes the correct repeat days.

My video cannot be selected

Allow Photos access when prompted and choose a video under two minutes. Camera and microphone permissions are required only when you record a new video.

How does “Done” unlock?

For a message alarm, the button unlocks after the reading time you selected. For a video alarm, it unlocks when the selected motivation video reaches the end.

How do I change or delete an alarm?

Open the Alarms tab, select the alarm, and edit its time, goal, content, repeat days, or snooze settings. The delete action is available from the alarm details.

Where are my videos stored?

Videos selected or recorded for an alarm stay in the app’s local storage on your iPhone. See the privacy policy for details.
